notes: Table 0 is a single combined export: product identity (SKU, Product name), a price block (Price list, Net price, Tax included, Tax rate) and an inventory block (Location, Available). Mapping should explode /prices once per SKU and /inventory once per SKU×Location, and the inventory identity key /warehouse_code is satisfied by Location (KUL, JHB).
SKU is zero-padded in the source (00470001…) but the profiler typed it as int; it must be emitted as a string with leading zeros intact per the operator requirement ('preserve leading zeros').
Currency 'MYR' is explicit column evidence; no FX conversion is requested or performed. Do not substitute the schema default 'THB'.

'Tax included = No' with 'Tax rate = 5%' means the Net price amounts are VAT-exclusive; vat_included=false and vat_rate=0.05 are emitted per file evidence. Whether 5% should be treated as a real applicable rate is out of scope — the operator states tax percentages in these files are fictional fixture values.

Unresolved / absent in this file: no barcode, brand, category, description, status/active flag, reserved quantity, and no effective_from / effective_to dates. Per the operator instruction to retain unresolved fields rather than publish guessed values, these pointers should stay null/absent rather than be defaulted or invented.

Net price appears once per SKU (12 distinct prices for 12 SKUs) while Available varies per location; confirm at execution that both location rows of a SKU carry the same Net price before collapsing to one price entry per SKU × price_list.

tables.reason: One row per SKU per location (24 rows = 12 distinct SKUs × 2 locations KUL/JHB). The row grain is SKU-level product identity plus a price block (Price list/Net price/Tax included/Tax rate) that repeats per SKU and an inventory block (Location/Available) that varies by warehouse. So the table is a product master exported flat with price and stock fanned out, not a pure stock or pure price table.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU' is a direct synonym of /sku. Detected distinct values are zero-padded codes 00470001–00470012 (profile typed the column int, but top_values retain the leading zeros); must be read as text and leading zeros preserved, never strip_leading_zeros or cast to int.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header matches /product_name synonym; values are human-readable item names (SIM care 1..10…) with one name per SKU. Required field.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency' is an explicit /currency synonym and the single value 'MYR' is a valid ISO-4217 3-letter code matching the ^[A-Z]{3}$ pattern. This is stated in the file, not inferred from country or brand; no FX conversion is implied.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit' is an explicit unit.sell synonym; single value 'PCS' normalizes to the enum_hint value PCS via unit_normalize. No pack-size information present in the file.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list' is a direct /prices/*/price_list synonym; single constant value 'standard', which is also the schema default, so no inference is needed.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price' appears among price.amount synonyms and values are decimal amounts (1234.56–1356.77) with one value per SKU, non-null. This is the numeric price to emit as /prices/*/amount, paired with price_list 'standard'.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included' is an explicit vat_included synonym and values are a single boolean-like 'No' throughout, meaning the stated net price is VAT-exclusive → vat_included=false.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate' matches price.vat_rate; single value '5%' throughout. Parsed with parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction) to 0.05. The 5% is a fixture value taken from the file, not an assumed statutory rate.

columns.name: Location
columns.reason: Header 'Location' is a warehouse synonym; exactly two codes KUL (12 rows) and JHB (12 rows) split the 12 SKUs into two stock entries each, so it is the per-warehouse key of the inventory collection.

columns.name: Available
columns.reason: Header 'Available' is a stock.qty synonym ('available'/'qty available'); every row has a distinct integer 10–41 and it varies by SKU×Location, so it is the on-hand quantity for the warehouse indicated by Location.
